items.title: Citi opens downside catalyst watch on Kroger as Walmart price war intensifies
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has opened a short-term downside catalyst watch on Kroger (NYSE: KR) ahead of second-quarter results on Sept. 11, warning that intensifying price competition from Walmart could pressure the grocer's comparable sales and margins.

items.title: Open-weight AI models overtake proprietary rivals in developer usage, Citi says
items.summary: Open-weight artificial intelligence models, whose underlying settings are released for anyone to download and run rather than locked behind a company's paywall, have passed a milestone in developer usage. They made up 53% of token volume on Vercel's AI Gateway on 25 August, according to a new...

items.title: Kroger shares fall 1.2% after Citi issues short-term downside watch
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) shares fell 1. 2% in pre-market trading after Citi placed the supermarket group on a short-term downside Catalyst Watch ahead of its second-quarter 2026 earnings report.

items.title: AMZN Stock Slips On $20B FTC Ad Lawsuit: Citi Calls Pullback A ‘Buying Opportunity’ As Amazon ‘Strongly Disagrees’ With Allegations
items.summary: Citi said continued advertiser spending and accelerating AI demand at AWS support its bullish view of Amazon.

items.title: BAC Records 9% Y/Y Growth in NII in 1H26: Will the Uptrend Continue?
items.summary: Bank of America's NII rises 9% y/y to $31.7B in 1H26, led by loan and deposit growth and asset repricing, with gains expected through the rest of 2026.

items.title: Citi sees Permian Basin entering multi-year natural gas growth cycle
items.summary: The Permian Basin is moving into a multi-year expansion phase for natural gas infrastructure that could ease the takeaway constraints that have long affected the region, according to Citi analysts. The bank said the latest investment cycle differs from previous periods because infrastructure development is being supported by more durable sources of demand.

items.title: JPM Stock Gains 20.6% in 3 Months: Key Factors to Watch Before Buying
